lessons.title: A balanced opinion
lessons.summary: Выражай мнение уверенно и добавляй нюансы.

exercises.title: Связывай идеи
exercises.explanation: Используй however для контраста, therefore для результата и although для уступки.

exercises.example: From my perspective, flexible hours improve productivity.

exercises.prompt: С моей точки зрения, это разумное решение.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: From my perspective, this is a sensible decision.
acceptedAnswers: In my view, this is a sensible decision.

exercises.prompt: Однако у этого подхода есть недостатки.
The plan is expensive. ___, it may save time later.

exercises.example: The role is demanding. That being said, it is rewarding.

exercises.prompt: Хотя я понимаю твою точку зрения, я не совсем согласен.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Although I understand your point, I do not entirely agree.
acceptedAnswers: Although I understand your point, I don't entirely agree.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: As a result, the team finished earlier.

exercises.prompt: ___ the risks, the idea is worth testing.
Главное преимущество заключается в том, что система проста.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The main advantage is that the system is simple.
acceptedAnswers: The key advantage is that the system is simple.
